title: iv/0.1
description: Profile for instrumental-variables models (fixest, ivreg; pyfixest, linearmodels IV; ivreghdfe, ivreg2, ivregress). Requires inference/0.1 plus specification.endogenous and specification.instruments, and structures.first_stage. Written from the design doc's one-line requirement; the cross-tool survey of first-stage diagnostics has not been done, so the first_stage names below are a proposal. A FE IV record also claims linear-fe/0.1.

first_stage.description: First-stage diagnostics. Proposed: a table with one row per endogenous regressor (columns such as endogenous, f_stat, partial_r2, sw_f) and/or an object with joint statistics (kp_rk_lm, kp_rk_wald_f, cd_wald_f). Per-coefficient first-stage estimates go in parameters with component "first_stage".
